# Sub-base C Characters Live Verification Fixture

This fixture contains only character information and character-to-character relationships.
It intentionally contains no locations, events, objects, abilities, or magic abilities as extraction targets.

## Character A — explicit and inferred profile

Mira Stonewell is a 31-year-old woman and a reluctant guardian. She is 5 feet 8 inches tall, with black hair and green almond-shaped eyes. Mira has an oval face, high cheekbones, a broad forehead, and a straight nose. She wears a dark-blue wool coat, leather boots, a silver moon pendant, and a thin copper ring. A narrow scar crosses her left eyebrow, and a small crescent tattoo is visible on her right wrist.

Mira Stonewell is also known to the wardens as Stonewatch. She is observant, patient, and protective of people who cannot defend themselves. She carefully records every clue before making a decision, which makes her methodical and cautious. Mira wants to protect the forbidden archive even when doing so puts her at risk.

## Character B — relationship target

Dorian Vale is a 35-year-old man and an archivist. He has brown hair, gray eyes, and a tall, lean build. Dorian speaks quietly and precisely. He trusts Mira Stonewell, and Mira and Dorian are trusted allies who protect one another. Dorian relies on Mira when danger threatens, while Mira relies on Dorian for careful research.

## Relationship evidence

Mira and Dorian work together as allies. Their alliance is based on mutual trust and shared protection. Mira is the person who protects Dorian when he cannot defend himself, and Dorian provides Mira with reliable research and advice.
